items.title: SIMD and Go: How the New Packages Work Under the Hood
Spinning is a Bounded Bet: Why Go Hides Its Spinlocks
items.blurb: A handmade spinlock in Go looks like eight lines of code. The missing ninth line is a policy, and the policy needs context the lock word cannot see.

MyGo: Build Desktop Apps in Go with No Cgo Required
items.blurb: Build desktop apps in Go. Windows draw native UI that MyGo paints on the GPU, written in Go alone with package ui, or show a web frontend in the system webview that calls Go through a TypeScript client generated from your code.

items.title: Dancing Backwards with Go: Why TDD Feels Weird
items.blurb: “Write tests… first ? That sounds backwards.” I know exactly what you mean, but stay with me. This is going somewhere… backwards, and in high heels!
